Hi Amara,

The webhook for order updates is live on your staging store as of this afternoon. It sends a POST to the endpoint you gave us whenever an order moves to shipped or refunded, and it includes the Shopify ID in the payload.

Two things to confirm on your side: that your endpoint returns a 200 within 5 seconds, and that it can handle the same event twice, since we retry on timeouts.

Once you confirm, Okafor will switch it on in production.

Best,
Liam
